description: Defines the SparseCsrTensorImpl class implementing a sparse CSR tensor in PyTorch, including data structures, methods for resizing, setting tensors, and copying metadata.

classes.name: SparseCsrTensorImpl
classes.description: Implementation of a sparse CSR tensor in PyTorch, managing tensor data and layout, with methods for resizing, copying, and interfacing with dispatch modes.

methods.name: resize_
methods.description: Resizes the sparse tensor to a specified number of non-zero elements and size.

methods.name: resize_and_clear_
methods.description: Resizes the tensor and clears its data.

methods.name: resize_as_sparse_compressed_tensor_
methods.description: Resizes the tensor to match another sparse compressed tensor.

methods.name: set_member_tensors
methods.description: Sets the internal tensors for indices and values.

methods.name: compressed_indices
methods.description: Returns the tensor of compressed row indices.

methods.name: plain_indices
methods.description: Returns the tensor of column indices.

methods.name: values
methods.description: Returns the tensor of non-zero values.

methods.name: nnz
methods.description: Returns the number of non-zero elements.

methods.name: set_size
methods.description: Sets the size of a specific dimension.

methods.name: set_stride
methods.description: Sets the stride of a specific dimension.

methods.name: layout_impl
methods.description: Returns the layout of the tensor.

methods.name: set_layout
methods.description: Sets the tensor layout, with validation.

methods.name: shallow_copy_and_detach_core
methods.description: Creates a shallow copy of the tensor, detaching from dispatch modes if necessary.

methods.name: shallow_copy_and_detach
methods.description: Returns a shallow copy of the tensor, with optional detachment.
